title: 2-D Correlation
text: Compute 2-D correlation of two input matrices, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Output size} sets Size of cross-correlation output; {Normalized output} sets the normalize cross-correlation output and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output size
params.values: Size of cross-correlation output Full (default) | Same as input port I1 | Valid

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
